scope: Experimental isolated simulator root-executability diagnostics; no new game-rule/card certification, legal mask, training admission, or strength claim.

smoke.scope: Experimental simulator executability only; not legality, not training admission, not strength.

counting: Candidate status counts cover forward only. Engine, prefix-root and elapsed counts cover forward plus reverse. Timing is one bounded diagnostic run, not production throughput.

deepseek.acceptance: Primary checked every quoted line and all copied/current file SHA256 values; independently reviewed critical diagnostic, choice and prefix paths. This is mechanical software evidence, not full semantic endorsement of worker prose.

limits: New MatchEngine per candidate; shared static IR/defaults and CardDefinition objects remain in the same process.
Snapshot, trace, RNG/clock and request comparisons do not prove all VM/private-state equivalence.
Accepted/Rejected means current simulator root boolean only; does not prove target honored, legal target completeness or authoritative game legality.
Nested choices, VM/unsupported/missing-call faults, unresolved choices, exceptions and prefix discrepancies remain Unknown.
Reference historical callback faults are not recoverable from MatchEngine alone.
Work caps bound candidates and replay roots; no independent process or wall-clock timeout.
Smoke uses empty card vectors, 2 decks, seed 1 and 12 prefixes; no general performance or hidden-information certification.
failureProof: Five diagnostic contract regressions and injected faults; not an authoritative rule-defect fail-before/fix-after claim. Initial rejected-case fixture required one preceding play; fixture correction was not a production bug fix.
matrix: Rebuilt at batch end; retained existing stale/partial evidence and did not reset reviewed-source fingerprints. Aggregate SelfTest source changes can add a stale reason without proving a rule regression.
next: Make Unknown diagnostics actionable with candidate command and missing-call provenance, then verify target execution semantics before any legal-mask or policy integration.
